The warm liner pairs 400g of Thinsulate insulation with 3mm of wool felt for warmth without the bulk. The supportive 6oz leather upper has neoprene expansion darts for a snug, comfortable fit. The high traction Kenetrek K-Talon outsole provides serious grip in mud snow or dry ground. Rugged terrain and severe weather can make hunting in the backcountry brutal, but even the toughest of expeditions can become more enjoyable if you take good care of your feet. At Kenetrek, they build their boots “for the trail less traveled,” by punishing every product through a rigorous test phase that they can’t help but to enjoy. They know you will find total quality and performance with their products because they already have.

products.title: ASICS Women's UB3-S Gel-Nimbus 9 Shoes
products.description: The UB3-S GEL-NIMBUS 9 sneaker was created by the Kiko Kostadinov Studio. Inspired by the concept of outdoor exploration, the team repurposed our heritage trainer with influences found in nature. Elements from scenic landscapes and encounters with the sea are translated onto the upper’s color palettes. Meanwhile, utility features like the elongated tongue loops add to the shoe’s rugged aesthetic. The segmented midsole’s GEL technology inserts in the heel and forefoot are designed to increase shock absorption. This makes the shoe more adaptable for different surroundings.

products.title: BOGS Women's Forge STMG-M
products.description: New from Cloudsteppers, the Lola Point flip-flop featues a fresh knit textile upper with a matching footbed. Its cushy EVA Molded footbed and midsole promotes serious comfort for all day wear. Great for the beach, a barbeque or running errands. Urban and outdoor enthusiasts love Bogs. Always waterproof and warm, they walk comfortably, breathe naturally and combine modern style with rugged construction. Both the popular classics and the new MT series are available with waterproof breathable uppers. Everything we sell is backed with a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Enjoy.

result.title: Kenetrek Bobcat Cowboy Zip Insulated Pac Boot
result.features:
100% Leather
Rubber sole
Super thick 6 ounce oil tanned leather uppers are contoured to fit your leg precisely.
Oversized heavy duty zippers are easy to operate with one hand yet stand up to the toughest conditions.
Removable 6 mm thick three part liner quilted from a wicking durable synthetic, 400 grams of Thinsulate Ultra Insulation, and finally 3 mm of wool felt to insulate even when damp.
Hand made rubber cowboy bottoms feature a roper style toe and steel shanks with double thick midsoles.
Stirrup friendly Kenetrek Cowboy Outsole design has a deep and open tread design for serious grip in snow and mud while the Stirrup Rail that surrounds the K-lugs keep them from catching on anything but the ground.

top_reviews.title: Nice quality boot but this style did not work well for me
top_reviews.text: As a woman, I am looking for a winter riding boot that fit well, be warm and stirrup friendly. Everything I read on these boots seemed to be very positive, and when they arrived they seem very well made.  However, the zip style and shorter height did not fit well around my ankle, and felt very clumsy.  I returned these and am ordering the taller lace up style, hoping those will work.
